thread:
maria (product): Need a short contract for when we serve a compatibility/cheaper variant. Can we agree on surface and console tags?

sam (eng-platform): Keep it minimal: HTTP 200, small `route` field in response, optional verbose warning. No new status codes.

tess (eng-runtime): runtime already emits ROUTE_COMPAT. Proposal: public values `route.kind=compat` and `route.variant=compat-lite` (labels only). Add trace tag rw.route_kind and rw.variant_label.

lee (devex): Console UX: per-route pill "compat (1.2%)" with tooltip "Served by compatibility variant to preserve latency". No global banner unless >10%. Allow org opt-in to show warnings in responses.

nav (eng-sre): Telemetry: metrics rw.compat.count, rw.compat.pct, rw.compat.latency_p95. Alerts: warn at 5% sustained 6h, crit at 20% sustained 24h. Add nightly sampling of compat responses for automated evals.

sam (eng-platform): API snippet: header `X-RW-Route: compat|primary|cached` body: "route": {"kind":"compat","variant":"compat"}. Hosted defaults to label-only. Dedicated can opt into hashed ids.

maria (product): Good. Rollout: internal 48h -> alpha opt-in -> GA. Owners: sam RFC, lee console, nav alerts, tess sampling.

all: +1
